description: Interactive-environment substrate (GP-250): transition-program identification on sealed synthetic grid e01.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Evidence is an episode log of grid transitions, not (x, y) numeric pairs; exact-match scoring runs in gate_harness.py against the typed episode JSONLs (visible replay + hidden-holdout full-depth rollout), which is the discrete_exact contract for this substrate.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rival transition laws are separated by counterfactual probe signatures and MDL within the committee, not by math-form keywords.
persona: Adversarial reviewer of transition programs: assumes every candidate memorizes until replay and held-out rollout prove otherwise; hunts unwitnessed contexts, absorbing states, and guard-family ambiguity; refuses identification claims from committees larger than one.
